modules.name: examples/options/crr

defs.doc:
The CRR value with N steps: u = exp(sigma sqrt(dt)), d = 1/u, the
risk-neutral up probability p = (exp((r - q) dt) - d) / (u - d), values
rolled back from maturity; an American option takes the larger of
continuing and exercising at every node.
